sponsors.cursor: Optional per Official Rules 8.1; not used. Development used Claude Code. No Cursor credits were provided for this event.
meterless_engines: H-MEM - vendored official reference (Apache-2.0), wired into the agent loop: past calls recalled into debate packets, outcomes supersede records after scoring (src/agent/memory.py)
sponsors.meterless_runtime: Runtime 1.4 OpenAI-compatible provider implemented in src/integrations/llm.py; Nightshift is the primary AI provider route when configured (LLM_PROVIDER=meterless or a Meterless base URL/token present). Integration basis: Meterless team guidance Oct 19, confirmed directly to this project Oct 23 (HackOS #Help Meterless). RESOLVED Oct 26: Nightshift M1-M4 0.92.7 serves the Runtime at 127.0.0.1:8088; the full Oct 26 live run went through it (9/9 calls, model logged per call, mean 60.5s, grounding 91/91). Every model call is logged per run (provider, served model, latency) in artifacts.json.
sponsors.nvidia: Nemotron (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b) powers the bull/bear/judge debate; model name logged per request in run artifacts. Oct 22-23 runs used NVIDIA direct API, confirmed by the Meterless team (Oct 19, and directly to this project Oct 23) as fine for the NVIDIA award; the Oct 26 run served Nemotron THROUGH Nightshift, meeting the strict Rule 15.2 reading as well.
sponsors.zetaris: Data harness: 46 REST tables over Yahoo Finance (quotes/bars via SQL through the Zetaris REST API); options chains via Yahoo direct (no options tables in Zetaris).
